title: benzoin assamicum
intro: Benzoin assamicum, commonly known as Styrax tonkinensis, is a plant species native to the forests of Vietnam and other parts of Southeast Asia. It is known for its resinous bark and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Benzoin assamicum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The plant's bioactive constituents include resin, styrax, and benzoin, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and analgesic properties.
